verdict.rationale: The evidence references a public /pricing page but only shows marketing language about 'flexibility of great pricing' for on-demand/spot capacity (coreweave-docs-20, coreweave-docs-35); no actual per-GPU-hour dollar figures for any GPU type are shown anywhere in the pack, and billing docs only describe post-usage cost breakdowns (coreweave-docs-13, coreweave-docs-34), not upfront published rates.
